notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-oA saves all three Nmap output formats simultaneously: .nmap (human-readable), .gnmap (grepable, one host per line), .xml (structured, tool-importable). Default best practice — no extra cost, maximum flexibility.

=== FORMAT USE CASES ===
.nmap: quick reading, overview. .gnmap: grep/awk/cut processing (grep 'open' file.gnmap | cut -d' ' -f2). .xml: import into Metasploit (db_import), generate HTML report via xsltproc, parse with scripts.

=== ENGAGEMENT PRACTICE ===
Save every scan. Different runs and scan types return different results. File comparison reveals intermittent firewall behavior or service instability. Preserves evidence for reporting.
